text:
sophia (releases): cutting RC now -> sha: d4f9e8b. Requesting 90m pin and a 20m quiet window after promote.

deploy-bot: build finished: gcr.io/redwood/serve:rc-d4f9e8b. preflight ok. artifact size 1.1GB. checks: kv-warm=80%, batch avg=3.

eden (qa): quick staging smoke done. one rerank test flaky, retried and passed. noticed small increase in tail latency on embed-worker (~120ms).

max (oncall): propose canary steps 3% -> 20% -> 60% with 8m holds. i'll monitor p50/p95 and 5xx.

cho (sheriff): rollback thresholds suggested: p95 > 350ms sustained 2m OR error_rate > 0.7% over 5m OR OOM events.

sophia (releases): added thresholds to ticket. pinning artifact now. ticket: https://t.releases/RC-d4f9e8b (internal).

deploy-bot: starting promotion. canary id cb-20260321-09. routing 3% to canary.

eden (qa): canary at 3% 9: no increase in 5xx. error_rate 0.08%.

max (oncall): small p95 blip at +6m on embed-worker. checking pod OOMs.

cho (sheriff): logs show one kube OOM kill on embed-worker around +6m. recommend scaling replica pool then pause auto shifts.

sophia (releases): scaling embed-worker pool by +2 replicas now, pausing further shifts.

deploy-bot: auto-shift paused by manual hold (sophia).

max (oncall): after scaling, p95 back to baseline. suggest continue to 20% with 12m hold.

cho (sheriff): agree. note: if we see another OOM or p95 breach > 350ms for 2m, rollback immediately.

sophia (releases): resuming traffic to 20% now.

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 20%. canary healthy.

eden (qa): telemetry stable. running a quick synthetic against rerank and embeddings. all pass.

sophia (releases): proceeding to 60% after hold. will keep 90m pin after full promotion for monitoring. release notes draft: "Promoted RC d4f9e8b to prod. Observed transient embed-worker OOM during 3% canary; mitigated by scaling. Rollback: p95>350ms (2m), error_rate>0.7% (5m), OOM events."

deploy-bot: shifting to 60% now. finalizing promotion.

max (oncall): monitoring ok, no further OOMs.

cho (sheriff): closing active watch. will open a follow-up ticket to investigate OOM root cause. :thumbsup:

sophia (releases): promo finished at ts=7273456860. keeping pin for 90m. thanks all!
